title: Symbol-U Deployment and Infrastructure Guide
content:
Symbol-U deployment options and requirements:

**Cloud Hosted (Default):**
- Fully managed SaaS deployment
- Multi-region availability (US, EU, APAC)
- Automatic scaling and updates
- 99.9% uptime SLA (Enterprise)

**On-Premise Deployment:**

Requirements:
- Kubernetes 1.25+ cluster
- 16GB RAM minimum per node
- GPU recommended for inference (NVIDIA A10 or better)
- PostgreSQL 14+ for metadata
- Redis 7+ for caching

Docker Compose (Development):
```yaml
services:
  symbolu-api:
    image: symbolu/api:latest
    ports: ["8000:8000"]
  symbolu-frontend:
    image: symbolu/frontend:latest
    ports: ["3000:3000"]
```

Helm Chart (Production):
```bash
helm repo add symbolu https://charts.symbolu.ai
helm install symbolu symbolu/symbolu-stack \
  --set api.replicas=3 \
  --set ingress.enabled=true
```

**Environment Variables:**
- ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: Claude API access
- GOOGLE_API_KEY: Gemini API access
- DATABASE_URL: PostgreSQL connection
- REDIS_URL: Cache connection
- DAILY_TOKEN_LIMIT: Per-user daily limit
